Maya: Heads-up: sprint kickoff to finalize private-deploy packaging options. Focus: 1) non-k8s agent flow, 2) deterministic upgrade ordering for multi-proxy topologies, 3) explicit egress modes for customer-managed networking, 4) airgap/offline installer. Need quick alignment.

Owen: For deterministic upgrades we should provide an explicit operator-mode: `upgrade-sequence = ["proxy-a","proxy-b","proxy-c","proxy-d"]` and a dry-run `--plan` output so NetOps can validate order.

Priya: Launch gating checklist idea: - Pilot customers (NetCorp + one small internal) must validate IP-preservation and deterministic sequence; - Security audit of offline installer + GPG signatures; - Rollback playbook tested in staging with <1h RTO; - Telemetry must be opt-in and documented.

Jon: Installer specifics: create single compressed bundle `redwood-agent-vX.Y.Z.tar.gz` with `install.sh` that verifies a detached signature and exits non-zero on mismatch. Example verify: `gpg --batch --verify agent.tar.gz.sig agent.tar.gz`. Include `--check-space` early.

Maya: Network modes we plan to document: 1) SOURCE-PASSTHROUGH (customer preserves IP), 2) SNAT (agent/NAT maps source), 3) RELAY (customer relay/proxy), 4) RELAY+IP-PINNING. Each mode needs clear rollback semantics in the playbook.

Owen: Edge-case: when using SOURCE-PASSTHROUGH with multiple proxies, we must support pinning sessions to egress IPs so clients don't see auth anomalies. Add acceptance test for session-stability across upgrades.

Priya: Security note: KMS blobs must be importable offline. Acceptance test: import encrypted key blob -> sign challenge -> rotate keys locally -> verify signature without contacting control plane.

Jon: Suggest adding a small telemetry opt-in config flag in `agent.conf` and default to false. Document what hashes are sent when enabled.

Maya: Action items: Owen -> draft upgrade-sequence RFC + `--plan` CLI output; Jon -> packager + install.sh stub; Priya -> launch-gate checklist + security tests; I'll coordinate pilot invites and release notes.

ops-bot: Ticket #5231 created by Owen: upgrade-sequence-rfc (https://git.internal/t/5231)

Owen: Adding note: require zero-schema-change of admin API at launch to avoid field/conversion issues.

Priya: Aiming to have checklist ready for review by Thursday.

Maya: Thanks team. We'll review RFCs in tomorrow's sync.
